title: Breast Cancer Screening Guidelines May Miss Many Young Women
subtitle: New research suggests current methods for identifying high-risk patients under 50 need a serious update.

summary.en: New research shows that current medical guidelines in England fail to identify most young women at risk of breast cancer. The existing system relies heavily on family history, which misses many patients who later develop the disease. Experts from the University of Cambridge and the Institute of Cancer Research suggest that new, more detailed assessment tools are needed. While these tools could save lives through early detection, they also present challenges regarding costs and medical resources. Health officials are now facing calls to review and improve these screening criteria.
summary.zh: 最新研究顯示，英國目前的醫療準則未能識別出大多數有乳癌風險的年輕女性。現行系統過度依賴家族病史，導致許多後來發病的患者被遺漏。來自劍橋大學與癌症研究所的專家建議，需要採用更詳細的新型評估工具。雖然這些工具能透過早期發現來挽救生命，但也帶來了成本與醫療資源方面的挑戰。衛生官員目前正面臨要求檢討並改善這些篩檢標準的呼聲。

paragraphs.en: A new study has raised serious concerns about how doctors identify young women who are at risk of developing breast cancer. According to research from the University of Cambridge and the Institute of Cancer Research (ICR), the current guidelines used by family doctors in England miss as many as 95% of women under 50 who will develop the disease within a decade. These findings, published in the British Journal of Cancer, have led to urgent calls for a review of how medical professionals assess cancer risk.
paragraphs.zh: 一項新研究對醫師如何識別年輕女性罹患乳癌風險的方式提出了嚴重疑慮。根據劍橋大學 (University of Cambridge) 與癌症研究所 (Institute of Cancer Research, ICR) 的研究，英國家庭醫師目前所使用的準則，遺漏了高達百分之九十五、將在十年內罹患此病的五十歲以下女性。這些發表於《英國癌症期刊》(British Journal of Cancer) 的研究結果，引發了各界緊急呼籲，要求重新檢視醫療專業人員評估癌症風險的方式。

paragraphs.en: Breast cancer is the most common form of cancer globally. It is also a leading cause of death for women under 50. In England, family doctors—often called GPs—use specific criteria set by the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (Nice) to decide if a patient should be sent to a specialist for further testing. These guidelines are designed to help doctors find women who have a higher chance of getting the disease so that they can receive early treatment or preventive care.
paragraphs.zh: 乳癌是全球最常見的癌症類型，也是五十歲以下女性的主要死因。在英國，家庭醫師（通常稱為全科醫師）會使用由國家健康與照顧卓越研究院 (National Institute for Health and Care Excellence, Nice) 所制定的特定標準，來決定是否應將病患轉診給專科醫師進行進一步檢查。這些準則旨在協助醫師找出罹病機率較高的女性，以便她們能及早接受治療或預防性照護。

paragraphs.en: However, the study suggests that the current system is not working as well as it should. The primary problem is that the Nice guidelines focus heavily on family history. If a woman does not have relatives who have had breast cancer, she is less likely to be referred for further checks. The research found that nearly three-quarters of women under 50 who develop breast cancer within 10 years have no family history of the disease at all. Because the current system relies so much on family background, it fails to spot the vast majority of women who are actually at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，該研究指出目前的系統運作不如預期。主要問題在於 Nice 的準則過度依賴家族病史。如果一名女性沒有罹患乳癌的親屬，她被轉診進行進一步檢查的可能性就較低。研究發現，在十年內罹患乳癌的五十歲以下女性中，近四分之三完全沒有家族病史。由於目前的系統過於仰賴家族背景，導致它無法找出絕大多數真正處於風險中的女性。

paragraphs.en: To test the effectiveness of the current rules, researchers compared them with a new risk assessment system called Boadicea. This system, which was funded by Cancer Research UK, looks at a much wider range of factors. Instead of just looking at family history, it considers a woman’s reproductive history, her lifestyle, and her genetics. When the researchers used this new tool, they were able to identify eight times as many women in the same age group who were at a higher-than-average risk of developing breast cancer.
paragraphs.zh: 為了測試現行規則的有效性，研究人員將其與一套名為 Boadicea 的新風險評估系統進行比較。這套由英國癌症研究協會 (Cancer Research UK) 資助的系統，考量的因素範圍廣泛得多。它不僅僅關注家族病史，還納入了女性的生育史、生活型態與基因遺傳。當研究人員使用這項新工具時，他們在同一年齡層中，成功識別出罹患乳癌風險高於平均水準的女性人數，是原本的八倍之多。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Juliet Usher-Smith, from the University of Cambridge, explained why this matters. She noted that doctors need to be better at finding women at the highest risk. By identifying these women earlier, medical teams have more options to treat the disease or even prevent it from developing in the first place. She stated that because the current Nice criteria miss so many women, it is time to look at these rules again in light of the new evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 來自劍橋大學的尤瑟-史密斯博士 (Dr. Juliet Usher-Smith) 解釋了這項研究的重要性。她指出，醫師需要更有效地找出風險最高的女性。透過更早識別出這些女性，醫療團隊將有更多選擇來治療疾病，甚至從一開始就預防其發生。她表示，由於目前的 Nice 標準遺漏了太多女性，現在是根據這些新證據重新檢視規則的時候了。

paragraphs.en: While the findings are promising, experts warn that changing the system will not be simple. Prof. Montserrat García-Closas, from the ICR, pointed out that there is a difficult balance to strike. She explained that while the current Nice criteria are easy for doctors to use, they are not accurate enough. On the other hand, a more detailed system that includes genetic testing would require a lot of time, money, and medical resources. She described the situation as a trade-off between the practical costs of collecting data and the potential benefits of catching the disease earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管研究結果令人期待，但專家警告改變系統並非易事。來自癌症研究所的加西亞-克洛薩斯教授 (Prof. Montserrat García-Closas) 指出，這兩者之間存在難以取得的平衡。她解釋說，雖然目前的 Nice 標準對醫師而言易於使用，但準確度不足。另一方面，一套包含基因檢測且更為詳盡的系統，則需要投入大量的時間、資金與醫療資源。她將此情況描述為在收集數據的實際成本，與及早發現疾病的潛在效益之間進行權衡。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Simon Vincent, the chief scientific officer at the charity Breast Cancer Now, which supported the study, agreed that the findings are important. He suggested that finding better ways to identify women at increased risk could help detect cancers at a stage when treatment is much more likely to be successful. He emphasized that early detection is a key part of improving survival rates for young women.
paragraphs.zh: 支持這項研究的慈善機構「乳癌現在」(Breast Cancer Now) 的科學長文森博士 (Dr. Simon Vincent) 同意這些發現至關重要。他建議，找到更好的方法來識別風險增加的女性，有助於在治療成功率較高的階段檢測出癌症。他強調，早期發現是提高年輕女性存活率的關鍵。

paragraphs.en: As the medical community discusses these findings, the focus remains on how to best protect patients. The debate highlights the tension between using simple, quick tools and investing in more complex, accurate assessments. For now, the research serves as a clear reminder that current screening methods may need to evolve to keep up with our growing understanding of cancer risks. Whether or not the guidelines will be updated remains to be seen, but the call for change is growing louder among health experts.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著醫學界討論這些研究結果，焦點仍放在如何妥善保護病患。這場辯論凸顯了在運用簡單、快速的工具，與投資更複雜、精確的評估方式之間所存在的拉鋸。目前，這項研究清楚提醒我們，現行的篩檢方法或許需要演進，才能跟上我們對癌症風險日益增長的認知。這些準則是否會更新仍有待觀察，但衛生專家要求改革的呼聲正日益高漲。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to notice, identify, or include someone or something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「錯過」（如錯過火車），這裡指醫生未能診斷出病患。文中：the current guidelines used by family doctors in England miss as many as 95% of women under 50 who will develop the disease within a decade.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To achieve or find a balance between two opposing things.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「打擊」，這裡與 balance 連用，指在兩者間取得平衡。文中：Prof. Montserrat García-Closas, from the ICR, pointed out that there is a difficult balance to strike.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation where you must accept less of one thing in order to have more of another.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞片語 trade off 演變而來的名詞，指為了得到某種好處而必須放棄另一種東西。文中：She described the situation as a trade-off between the practical costs of collecting data and the potential benefits of catching the disease earlier.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason the current Nice guidelines are considered ineffective for women under 50?

options.A: They require genetic testing that is too expensive for most patients.
options.B: They place too much emphasis on family history when assessing risk.
options.C: They are too complicated for family doctors to understand and implement.
options.D: They ignore lifestyle factors entirely in favor of reproductive history.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，目前的 Nice 指引過度依賴家族病史（focus heavily on family history），而研究發現近四分之三的年輕乳癌患者並無家族病史。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到基因檢測是未來可能使用的工具，而非現行指引的內容。選項 C 錯誤，文章反而提到現行指引因為簡單才被使用，但準確度不足。選項 D 錯誤，文章並未說現行指引完全忽略生活方式，而是強調其對家族病史的過度依賴。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the Boadicea system compared to the current Nice criteria?

options.A: It is guaranteed to be adopted by all doctors in England immediately.
options.B: It is less accurate than the Nice criteria because it considers too many factors.
options.C: It requires a more comprehensive data collection process from patients.
options.D: It was developed specifically to replace the need for early cancer treatment.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段與第六段，Boadicea 系統考量了生殖史、生活方式及遺傳等廣泛因素，這暗示了它需要收集比現行指引更多的患者資訊。選項 A 錯誤，文章僅提到呼籲改變，並未保證會被採用。選項 B 錯誤，文章指出 Boadicea 能識別出多出八倍的高風險患者，顯示其更準確。選項 D 錯誤，該系統的目的是為了更早發現癌症以利治療，而非取代治療本身。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'strike' mean in the phrase 'a difficult balance to strike'?

options.B: To achieve or establish a state of equilibrium.
options.C: To refuse to work as a form of protest.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境中，strike a balance 是一個固定用法，意指在兩個對立的事物（如準確度與成本）之間取得平衡。選項 A 是 strike 的字面意思（擊打），不符合文意。選項 C 指的是勞工罷工，與醫療政策討論無關。選項 D 雖然 strike 有發現的意思，但在此處並非指發現價值，而是指建立一種平衡的狀態。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding breast cancer screening?

options.A: Family doctors in England are failing to provide any care to women under 50.
options.B: Genetic testing is the only way to prevent breast cancer in young women.
options.C: The Boadicea system is the final solution to all cancer screening problems.
options.D: Existing screening guidelines for young women need to be re-evaluated to improve early detection.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於討論現行篩檢指引的不足，並強調在證據支持下，醫學界呼籲重新檢視篩檢標準，以提升早期發現率。選項 A 過於誇大，文章僅指出指引有缺失，而非醫生完全不提供照護。選項 B 錯誤，文章並未說基因檢測是唯一方法。選項 C 錯誤，文章提到改進系統涉及成本與資源的權衡，且 Boadicea 只是研究中提到的工具之一，並非被視為完美的最終解決方案。
